## Summary
CI for Gerrit change 2480 exposed a py3.11 xdist leak: `tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py::test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip` created `.rebar-test-sidecar-material` under `Path.cwd()` / repo root. During xdist, another test could snapshot repo root while that directory existed and fail in `tests/conftest.py::_no_repo_root_leaks`.

## Root cause
The test fixture used a repo-root scratch directory for its synthetic tracker. That directory was briefly visible to unrelated tests. The fix uses pytest `tmp_path`, which is per-test disposable storage outside the checkout.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip` writes its synthetic tracker under `tmp_path`, not `Path.cwd()` / repo root.
- [x] The targeted sidecar-material test passes.
- [x] [non-codebase] The 29a6 Gerrit change 2480 Verified gate no longer fails on `.rebar-test-sidecar-material` repo-root leakage.
  provenance: environment=gerrit-verify-ci-prod; principal=rebar CI bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Gerrit REST confirms change 2480 status=MERGED at revision 6e3ecc060664 with Verified +1 by the rebar CI bot; on this project a merge requires Verified +1, so the merge attests the gate passed on the revision that moves the test onto tmp_path.

## Testing
- `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py::test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip -q` — passed.
- `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py::test_port_exhausted_routine_backoff_does_not_inflate_deploy_errors tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py::test_low_memory_routine_backoff_does_not_inflate_deploy_errors tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py::test_mcp_failure_keeps_the_deploy_failed_metric_and_names_the_component -q` — passed.
- `make lint` — passed.
- Gerrit change 2480 Verified rerun pending.
